title: Core: deployment, second-purpose request, complaint (SYNTHETIC)
author_note: Author-made. Entities are simulated: Federal Household Benefit Service (FHBS), Dubai Population Records Office (DPRO), Complaints and Oversight Office. Expected rulings are candidates for Walter's review, kept in hidden and never shown to roles.

steps.text: Step 1. The simulated Federal Household Benefit Service (FHBS) is live and popular. It proposes an AI eligibility pre-check that uses household and employment records held by the simulated Dubai Population Records Office (DPRO). The records were collected when residents registered for housing services. A human officer finalizes every decision. The service asks whether the pre-check may use these records.

Step 2. The FHBS asks the DPRO to release the registry fields for a second purpose: pre-screening applicants for a separate housing allowance. The DPRO states that the records were collected for housing registration only.

Step 3. A resident complains that the pre-check proposed a denial based on an inferred household-composition attribute, and that nobody told them an automated pre-check was used. The Complaints and Oversight Office asks what rules apply.
